shapes_taken_from: Fetch Price Data node URL -> Alpha Vantage GLOBAL_QUOTE response body keyed "Global Quote"
Fetch News Headlines node URL -> Finnhub company-news flat array of article objects
Fetch Reddit Mentions node URL -> Reddit search.json, data.children[] of kind t3
Aggregate & Calculate Sentiment node jsCode -> the field names the downstream step reads
provenance.values_note: Payload SHAPES are copied from the source workflow. Every VALUE is synthetic. Ticker FAKE / Fake Industries Inc. does not exist, no headline was published, no Reddit post exists. Nothing here is a market observation and nothing here may be cited as evidence (P3).
provenance.credentials: URLs carry ${ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY} / ${FINNHUB_API_KEY} placeholders only; no key value appears in any fixture.

duplicate_counting_rule: A duplicate is every occurrence of an identity key beyond the first. Three rows sharing one key count as 2 duplicates, not 3 and not 1.

required_fields.null_rule: A field present with value null counts as missing, not as present.

freshness_policy.basis: frozen_at, never wall-clock now() - these fixtures must not rot
freshness_policy.news_window: datetime within 2 days before frozen_at (matches the 2-day lookback in the source workflow Fetch News Headlines URL)
freshness_policy.reddit_window: created_utc within 24 hours before frozen_at (matches t=day)
freshness_policy.price_window: "07. latest trading day" within 5 calendar days of frozen_at (tolerates weekends and holidays)
freshness_policy.stale_definition: Any timestamp outside its window is stale and must be flagged, not silently dropped.

files.rows_basis: file does not parse; row count is undefined by design

defects.description: Latest trading day is roughly 2.5 years before frozen_at - a stale quote presented as current.

defects.description: File is not valid JSON. The extension is .json.broken on purpose: a truncated *.json under data/raw/ would fail the gate-3 test of this recipe permanently and would also trip scripts/conformance.mjs, so the fixture would break the repo instead of testing the validator.

expected_detection.expectation: one parse error naming the file; the step reports it and halts rather than raising an unhandled exception

defects.opt_in: The validator must be pointed at this file explicitly; no *.json glob will find it.

expected_totals.note: Totals a test can assert against the defective set. Duplicates follow duplicate_counting_rule.

clean_invariants: Every *.json file in the set parses.
In clean/, every required field is present and non-null on every row.
In clean/, no identity key repeats and no headline repeats.
In clean/, every timestamp falls inside its freshness window relative to frozen_at.
In clean/, the declared record_count equals the recounted row count.
No fixture contains a credential value; only ${VAR} placeholders.
No timestamp is generated from now() - the set is frozen and will not rot.
not_covered: Wrong-entity signals: a row that is well-formed, fresh, unique and required-field-complete but belongs to a different company. This is the defect class that reached a finished brief per logs/RUN_LOG.md#2026-08-26, and no shape check can catch it. Fixture ticker FAKE is unambiguous by construction, which is exactly why this set cannot exercise it.

Upstream HTTP failure modes: 401/403 on a bad key, 429 rate limit, timeout, empty 200 body. The ingest step needs these; they are envelope-level rather than record-level and belong in a second fixture set.
Encoding defects: mojibake, lone surrogates, BOM. The source workflow JSON is itself cp1252-hostile UTF-8, so this is a live risk.
Volume: the largest defective file holds 8 rows. Nothing here tests pagination, the reddit limit=50 ceiling, or memory behaviour.

Semantic sentiment correctness: the fixtures carry positive and negative keywords so the aggregate path executes deterministically, but this manifest asserts nothing about whether the resulting score is right - that is a human adequacy judgment (P1), not a conformance check.
